messages:
Ana (PM): quick thread — ACME wants to up their on-demand burst to 3x committed for a Q2 pilot. can we support this without a dedicated commit or should it be a contract-only add-on?

Mike (Pricing): this is a common ask. revenue risk if we let 3x w/o commit. options: temporary burst credits, per-request premium, or priority lane. need numbers: expected qps and token mix. :thinking_face:

Sahil (Sales): ACME says they're willing to pay for SLA & support. they expect 99.9% and <150ms p50 for chat. will push if engineering can promise it.

Courtney (Eng): technically we can shape it via per-customer concurrency + soft-queue + burst tokens. concerns: autoscaling lead time on cold starts, and noisy neighbor with huge sequence lengths. rough cost multiplier ~2.4x per token at that load.

Mike (Pricing): proposed pricing: tiered burst add-on: baseline up to 1.5x free, 1.5-3x @ 2.5x unit rate, >3x custom. trial credit of 100M tokens to validate.

Janet (Legal): contract note: must cap financial exposure + termination for abuse, and explicit SLA credits for burst failures. don't promise >99.5% without dedicated capacity clause.

Ana (PM): ok action items: 1) Courtney to draft perf constraints + run a 48hr sim (due EOD Wed). 2) Mike to model gross margin at proposed rates. 3) Sahil to get ACME's expected token qps. 4) Janet to propose contract language. i'll coordinate pilot definition.

Courtney (Eng): starting sim. sample config I used locally:

```
customer_burst:
  commit: 100M
  baseline_multiplier: 1.5
  burst_multiplier: 3
  throttling_strategy: soft_queue
  overage_policy: "charge_or_block"
```

Mike (Pricing): +1, include 95th percentile billing option.

Sahil (Sales): I'll ask ACME for a short rubric (expected peak, seasonality). pinging @ana if we should offer a one-time pilot discount.

Ana (PM): yes, pilot discount ok up to 25% but must be timeboxed to 60 days. I'll post a short pilot SOW after we get numbers.

launchbot (bot): Pilot created: pilot-ACME-burst-2026. thread closed unless blockers. :rocket:
